question: Will BTC reach an all time high by EOY?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if BTC/USD on CoinGecko records a price strictly above $126,210.50 (the current all-time high as of market creation) at any point before or at the market's settlement time on December 31, 2026 (23:59:59 UTC).
- "No": Wins if BTC/USD on CoinGecko does not record a price strictly above $126,210.50 at any point before or at the market's settlement time on December 31, 2026 (23:59:59 UTC).

Clarifications:
- "All-time high" is defined as the highest BTC/USD price ever recorded across CoinGecko's aggregated data prior to market creation, approximately $126,210.50 (reached on October 6, 2025). A new all-time high requires BTC to trade even one cent above this figure at any moment within the resolution window.
- If the verified all-time high at market creation differs slightly across sources, the CoinGecko lifetime peak figure takes precedence for setting the threshold.
